newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NOTIONNEL TO SLITHER TO 128.94.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NOTIONNEL TO SLITHER TO 128.94.

text.p: September notionnel futures are looking vulnerable after failing to maintain a double bottom pattern, technical analysts said on Wednesday.
"We had a double bottom extension level at 129.56, but we've gone back through there, so that negates it," said Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London.

September notionnel formed a double bottom on daily charts with the August 6 low of 128.96 and August 11 low of 128.94. The contract rose on Tuesday, but then fell through the August 7 high at 129.56, to a low of 129.38. It dropped 26 basis points to 129.36 by 0800 GMT.
The 128.94 bottom would form the base for Wednesday's trade, analysts said.

"We have been trading in a range and we broke out of it to the topside, but we failed to hold that at the open," said Miranda Churchill, independent technical analyst in London. "We will push down to the bottom of the range at 128.94."

Branigan found support ahead of that level at 129.26, a 61.8 percent retracement of the gains from the 128.94 August 11 low to the 129.78 Tuesday high. Notionnel reached a low of 129.26 earlier in the session.
Lower down, more support comes in at 128.42, Churchill said.
Daily charts show September notionnel gapped up from a high of 128.40 on June 12 to a low of 128.44 on June 13.
Tuesday's high of 129.78 would provide resistance, Branigan said.
"I would not expect to see the market back above 129.58, just above the double bottom peak and the middle of yesterday's late afternoon range," said Churchill.
September Pibor futures were down 0.02 at 96.48.
